citation_eligibility.empty_reference_rule: With no scientific results, exploratory empirical_search may use supporting_evidence=[]. Domain references and procedural knowledge do not support scientific conclusions. SELECT/STOP keep their original evidence gates.

mujoco_direct_control_v1.cost_scope: Response search: S=starts, D_i=effective active coefficients in update i; callbacks = S baselines + sum(D_i FD probes + 1 candidate evaluation per completed update), all within evaluation_requests. Partial/failed callbacks also consume the cap; recorded counts own actual cost. Each suffix rollout advances (deadline-state_time)/physics_dt steps. Native cost.physics_steps includes required prefix reconstruction and all native rollouts. evaluation_callbacks and optimization_evaluations describe the same rollouts, not extra runs. Full independent physical_replay is separate with its own physics_steps; new_physical_evaluations=0 does not mean native integration was free. ScientificQuestion full_task uses two endpoint knots and original default 16 iterations. For richer existing search, research_plan(action=control_search) accepts LocalControlSearchSettings with up to four knots and 100 iterations, under the frozen grant; its callbacks are independent physical replays, with backend charges, rather than Native mathematical rollouts. Neither interface changes task constraints or makes focus_metric an objective override.
